notes.title: First Free Dlc Goes Live Today - [Full Sex Turn]
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I'm the producer of the game, Stealer of Vegetables. We've received a lot of feedback and suggestions since the game was launched, so thank you for supporting and recognizing Doujinshi Man.
This update will bring you a very interesting free DLC - Full Sex Transformation!

In a nutshell: all human races and monsters have been changed into girls, except for the male protagonist, who is not a human male.

I believe that this Dlc update will bring you more different gaming experience~!
